prose: Riley Ellison requested a private psychoeducational evaluation to clarify learning and attention concerns for Casey Morgan Ellison that persist despite classroom supports. Presenting concerns include slow work completion and lost assignments. Riley Ellison aims to obtain clear recommendations for how to help Casey Morgan Ellison both at home and in school. Areas of suspected disability evaluated include Specific Learning Disability and Other Health Impairment.
